methodologyNotes: Prices sourced by fetching each vendor's official /pricing page directly on 2026-06-14. Rollbar (rollbar.com/pricing) and Bugsnag (bugsnag.com/pricing) render prices exclusively via client-side JavaScript; no dollar amounts appeared in the fetched HTML — those vendors' paid plan prices are recorded as null with aggregator fall-back notes. Raygun prices fetched from raygun.com/pricing and confirmed 33% annual discount stated on-page. Sentry prices confirmed on sentry.io/pricing and corroborated by getapp.com. Honeybadger prices confirmed on honeybadger.io/plans and corroborated by sourceforge.net. Airbrake prices confirmed on airbrake.io/pricing and cross-checked against slashdot.org listing. TrackJS prices confirmed on trackjs.com/pricing. LogRocket included as a widely-used adjacent vendor with public pricing on logrocket.com/pricing. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Sentry
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from https://sentry.io/pricing/ on 2026-06-14. HIPAA and BAA availability confirmed on the same page for Business and Enterprise tiers. Corroborated by getapp.com listing showing identical Team $26/mo and Business $80/mo figures.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: 1 user, 5,000 errors/month, 10 custom dashboards. Free forever.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Unlimited users, 50,000 errors/month, third-party integrations, 20 dashboards. Billed annually; month-to-month rate not separately published on pricing page.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Unlimited users, 50,000 errors/month, anomaly detection, advanced quota management, SAML+SCIM, HIPAA security and BAA included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Includes dedicated support, technical account manager, data locality options, single-tenant deployment.

vendors.name: Rollbar
vendors.provenance: Fetched https://rollbar.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-14. Page renders tier names (Free, Essentials, Advanced, Enterprise), credit allocations, and feature lists, but all USD dollar amounts for Essentials and Advanced are rendered exclusively via client-side JavaScript and did not appear in the fetched HTML. Free tier ($0) and Enterprise (custom) are confirmed. Paid plan prices recorded as null. sourceforge.net lists a starting price of $19/mo for Rollbar but this may be outdated given the credit-based model change. HIPAA BAA confirmed on the pricing page (standard BAA included; custom BAA for Enterprise).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5,000 occurrences/month, 1,000 replays/month, 30-day data retention. Unlimited users.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: 10K–50M occurrences/month, 4,000 credits/month included, up to 90-day data retention. USD price not rendered on fetched page — JS-gated pricing.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: 10K–50M occurrences/month, 8,000 credits/month included, up to 180-day data retention, SCIM provisioning. USD price not rendered on fetched page — JS-gated pricing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Minimum $4M annual plan per page content. 80M+ events, custom data retention, direct Slack support, priority SLAs.

vendors.name: Bugsnag
vendors.provenance: Fetched https://www.bugsnag.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-14. Page renders plan names (Free, Select, Preferred, Enterprise) and feature lists but all USD prices for Select and Preferred display '$0 /month' as a placeholder — actual pricing is JS-gated and not in fetched HTML. Alternativeto.net lists '$27–$59/month' range; sourceforge.net lists '$59/month' starting price billed annually; slashdot.org lists '$59/month'. These aggregators are likely outdated and do not agree on current structure. All paid plan prices recorded as null until a JS-rendered fetch is possible. On-premises PHI/PCI compliance mentioned but no explicit HIPAA BAA statement found.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, 7,500 events and 1M spans/month, 7-day data retention, 30+ integrations.

plans.name: Select
plans.notes: Unlimited users, 50K–3M events/month (tiered), 60-day data retention. USD price JS-gated; not visible in fetched HTML. Aggregators list starting price around $59/month billed annually but figures are unverified.

plans.name: Preferred
plans.notes: Unlimited users, 100K–3M events/month, dedicated Customer Success Manager, SSO, feature flags. USD price JS-gated.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Custom events/spans, sensitive data management, on-premises option, enhanced support.
